traced.note: Replaced: every road redrawn on the bands the lidar intensity shows (and the photo where the trees open): loops A, B and C and the park road sat 5 to 10 m off them in OpenStreetMap. Added loop B's middle lane (B005 to B013), its south lane with the turnaround (B015 to B021) and loop C's gravel lane past C007 to C017. OpenStreetMap's lane south of loop C (C022 to C024) shows on neither layer and is left out, as are the pull-ins to the pads.
